summary: JBS N.V. filed a Form 6-K on June 15, 2026, stating it posted a routine investor presentation on its website for use at conferences and meetings. No special situation—acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC, or management change—is disclosed. The filing is an ordinary current report of a foreign private issuer making a routine investor materials update, with no deal terms, board recommendations, or structural mechanics.
